San José y San Maximiliano Kolbe Montevideo - The Church of Saint Joseph and Saint Maximilian Kolbe (Spanish: Iglesia de San José y San Maximiliano Kolbe) popularly known as Iglesia de los Conventuales (due to its history as a former claustration convent) is a Roman Catholic parish church in Montevideo Uruguay.
